meta.description: Completed decompilation of the US release of Parasite Eve 2 on the Playstation 1.

commit.message: The police officers cleaned up: the rookie's and the sergeant's bodies, the two model initializers and the two model swaps are each one routine taking the officer, the culled bodies share their posing, the placement lookup and placing a model at a placement are helpers; the slot loops and the swaps' loops around the placement ids stay as the original's, said so; the tick returns its halfword flag instead of a masked word; the docs say what each part does, with an overview of the two tasks an officer is and how the scenes drive him, the rookie's unreachable steps among it
